title: France-based Alta Ares, which is building AI-powered air defense systems to counter drones and missiles, raised a €50M Series A led by Air Street Capital (Daphné Leprince-Ringuet/Sifted)
summary: Daphné Leprince-Ringuet / Sifted: France-based Alta Ares, which is building AI-powered air defense systems to counter drones and missiles, raised a €50M Series A led by Air Street Capital — Alta Ares builds interceptors which it says are currently deployed in several active combat zones
